nom: Knemo RIGHT AWAY Microtip Spot Patch - 2 Pack

avis.texte: This is the only patch that i have tried for acne on my neck and sticks!

these actually make my under the skin pimples disappear. i love that i can make them go down before it surfaces and becomes a whitehead and scars. this literally prevents pimples and i will always repurchase

avis.titre: A smarter way to stop acne scars
avis.texte: I find this patch works best when applied before the pimple fully develops—definitely more effective than waiting until after popping it. When I used to squeeze pimples, the scars were always worse and lasted longer. But with this patch, the healing feels quicker, and the marks left behind are much smaller. A gentle yet powerful way to manage breakouts without the damage!

avis.titre: A must for every girl who has period breakouts
avis.texte: You can feel the little microtips when you first press it on. I usually put one on a forming pimple at night and by morning, the bump's flatter and a lot smaller. It actually works faster than my usual spot treatments, and it stays on all night. I save these for the serious, early-stage breakouts that hurt under the skin.
